acts.title: The Dimming
acts.synopsis: Ember Hollow at dusk. The valley lanterns fail one by one, and twelve-year-old wind-cartographer apprentice Nia charts a wind no one else can see.

acts.title: The Last Flame
acts.synopsis: Grandmother Yara entrusts Nia with the keeper's lantern. The old wind-chart reveals the high cairn path above the gorge.

acts.title: The Mossback
acts.synopsis: Nia crosses the low valley and meets Ruel, the ancient mossback boar. Tested and trusted, he carries her across the washed-out gorge bridge.

acts.title: The Ascent
acts.synopsis: Storm climb to the high cairn. The flame nearly dies; the wind turns from adversary to guide.

acts.title: Hearthlight
acts.synopsis: The cairn is lit. Lanterns rekindle across the valley in a wave of light, and Nia takes the keeper's seat.

shots.board: Wide valley vista at dusk. Rows of small lantern dots along the hollow; three near ones visibly dark. Nia's hill silhouette at frame right with her wind-ribbon pole. Slow push in.

captions.line: Ember Hollow kept its light the way a heart keeps its beat. That autumn, the beat began to miss.

music.mood: hushed strings, low wind pad

shots.title: Lanterns going out

shots.board: Nia on the hilltop, cloak lifting in gusts. She ties paper ribbons to her survey pole; each ribbon streams a different way, mapping the unseen wind. Medium shot, gentle pan following ribbons.

captions.line: Twelve-year-old Nia was apprentice to the wind-cartographers. She could read air the way others read rivers.

music.mood: solo woodwind over soft strings

shots.title: The wind-cartographer

shots.board: Close on Nia's charcoal wind-chart: swirling arrows that refuse to settle, all bending away from the high cairn. Her hand stills. Match-cut framing to her eyes.

captions.line: That evening her chart would not close. Every wind bent around one place: the high cairn, dark for twenty years.

music.mood: nia theme fragments, unresolved

shots.title: The chart will not close

shots.board: Night falls fast. Two more lanterns gutter out along the hollow road in a visual beat, one, then another. Nia runs downhill toward grandmother's house, lantern-light shrinking behind her.

captions.line: Grandma Yara! The east row's gone dark, and the cairn wind is turning!

music.mood: low brass swell under strings

shots.title: Run down to Yara

shots.board: Inside Yara's lamplit house: walls of charts, a keeper's lantern burning blue-gold on the mantel. Yara, old and steady, studies Nia's chart and nods slowly. Warm interior, push in to the lantern.

captions.line: So. The valley finally asks what it has been owed for twenty years.
Then teach me the way up. Tonight.

music.mood: warm low strings, cradle rhythm

shots.title: What the valley is owed

shots.board: Yara lifts the keeper's lantern down and sets it in Nia's hands. The flame leans toward Nia, then steadies. Two-shot, slow orbit feel via drifting camera.

captions.line: This flame has burned through four keepers. It does not burn for the brave, little wind-reader. It burns for the steady.
I can be steady.

music.mood: nia theme and cairn hymn intertwined

shots.title: The keeper's lantern

shots.board: Yara unrolls the forbidden high chart: the gorge, the washed bridge, the cairn path marked in faded red. Her finger traces it; Nia copies the turns into her own small book. Overhead map shot.

captions.line: The bridge washed out in my mother's time. What crosses the gorge now crosses on four feet, if it crosses at all.

music.mood: solo cello line, sparse

shots.title: The forbidden chart

shots.board: Threshold farewell at the door: Yara knots a storm-ribbon into Nia's scarf. The valley behind them is nearly dark now, a handful of lights. Nia steps out with the lantern. Wide, hold, then rise.

captions.line: If the wind takes your map, follow the moss. If it takes your courage, follow the light. Come back a keeper, Nia.

music.mood: full string swell, first brass hint

shots.title: Threshold farewell

shots.board: Nia picks through the misty low valley, lantern high, ribbons streaming sideways in crosswinds. Reeds bend in waves. Tracking shot beside her, leaves tumbling past.

captions.line: The low valley did not want her there. Every gust read like a hand, pushing her back toward home.

music.mood: wind motif aggressive, strings short-bowed

shots.title: The low valley

shots.board: The moss grove: ancient stones furred green, breath-mist hanging. Two ember eyes open in the dark between roots. Ruel the mossback boar rises, huge, patient, antlered with lichen. Nia freezes. Slow push in.

captions.line: Little lantern. The bridge is gone. The gorge is hungry. Turn around.

music.mood: low ostinato, contrabass weight

shots.title: The mossback wakes

shots.board: The testing: Ruel circles Nia, snuffling the lantern, the charts, her trembling hands. She holds the lantern steady and shows him her wind-chart instead of running. The great head lowers. Intimate circling camera.

captions.line: You do not run. And you chart the wind instead of cursing it. Hm. Climb up, wind-reader. Hold the light clear of my ears.

music.mood: ostinato softens, nia theme enters low

shots.title: Tested and trusted

shots.board: The gorge crossing: broken bridge timbers jutting over black water far below. Ruel wades the ford with Nia on his back, lantern held high, spray bursting around his legs. Grand lateral sweep.

captions.line: Steady, little keeper. Water is only wind you can drink. Hold the light. Hold the light!

music.mood: full orchestra surge, brass over strings

shots.title: Across the gorge

shots.board: The storm slope: sleet slanting, Nia leading Ruel up switchbacks, lantern glass frosting. Her ribbons tear loose one by one and fly upward, toward the cairn. Diagonal upward tilt.

captions.line: One by one the storm took her ribbons. One by one she let them go, and watched where they flew.

music.mood: wind motif screaming, percussion of ice

shots.title: What the storm takes

shots.board: The flame nearly dies: a brutal gust flattens the lantern flame to a blue thread. Nia cups it with both hands and her own breath, shielding it with her body. Extreme close-up on hands and flame.

captions.line: Not yet. Not you. Breathe with me. In, and out, and in...

music.mood: near silence, single violin thread

shots.title: A blue thread

shots.board: The turn: the wind drops all at once and begins to push at Nia's back, uphill, toward the cairn. Snow lifts in guiding spirals. Ruel looks up the path and understands. Slow crane up.

captions.line: And then the wind changed its mind. All night it had pushed her back. Now it pushed her home.

music.mood: wind motif in major, strings blooming

shots.title: The wind changes its mind

shots.board: Final steps to the cairn stones: a dark ring of unlit braziers around a tall empty cairn. Nia climbs the last steps alone, Ruel waiting below, lantern flame standing tall now. Processional push in.

captions.line: Go on, little keeper. Twenty years we have waited for steady hands.

music.mood: cairn hymn gathering, choir-like strings

shots.title: The last steps

shots.board: The lighting: Nia touches the keeper's flame to the cairn bowl. Light blooms outward in a slow ring, braziers catching one by one around her. Her face, lit gold. Radiant slow bloom.

captions.line: She did not light a fire. She returned one.

music.mood: full orchestral arrival, cairn hymn blazing

shots.title: She returned one

shots.board: The rekindling wave: aerial view of Ember Hollow as lanterns relight in a rolling wave from the high cairn down to the last house. Tiny figures come to doors. Majestic pull-back.

captions.line: Down in the Hollow, the beat came back. Door by door, window by window, the valley remembered its light.

music.mood: all motifs united, bells over orchestra

shots.title: The valley remembers

shots.board: Coda at Yara's door at dawn: the old keeper watches the cairn light on the horizon and smiles. Nia's small figure descends the far path, new ribbons flying straight and true. Quiet two-plane parting shot.

captions.line: Come back a keeper, she had said. And down the bright path, the new keeper came.

music.mood: nia theme lullaby, solo woodwind farewell

shots.title: The keeper comes home

shots.board: Final frame: Nia on her hill at sunrise, keeper's lantern beside her, charting the morning wind with fresh ribbons. The valley glows below. Title card: HEARTHLIGHT. Slow fade to gold, hold, end.

captions.line: Ember Hollow keeps its light the way a heart keeps its beat. And the keeper keeps the Hollow.

music.mood: final hymn cadence, warm silence tail

shots.title: Hearthlight
